column1: Otto Lopez leads the slate with a strong combination of consistency and opportunity, reaching base safely in over 75% of games and benefitting from the leadoff spot, a favorable park, and the platoon edge against Noah Cameron. Jackson Chourio profiles nearly as steady atop Chicago’s lineup, also holding the platoon advantage and a high hit probability. Pete Alonso and Luis Arraez offer reliability, but Lopez’s track record and matchup make him the top pick for Beat The Streak players today.
